name: What should I prepare before requesting a curbless shower consultation?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before requesting a curbless shower consultation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before scheduling an estimate, measure your bathroom dimensions, locate your main plumbing wall, and identify your flooring type. Note whether your home sits on a concrete slab or over an open basement or crawlspace, as this helps contractors assess how the subfloor can be recessed. Gather design ideas for tile textures, drain styles (center or linear), and glass enclosures, and think about whether you need accessibility upgrades like wall blocking for grab bars. Knowing if your home has an alternate full bathroom for daily use during the two-to-three-week build is also helpful for project planning.
acceptedAnswer.description: Note your foundation type (slab or joists), locate existing plumbing walls, choose preferred tile styles, and consider your accessibility requirements before the estimate.
